definition: the act of looking carefully for something
description: A frantic couple turns their apartment upside down searching for lost keys: she digs under couch cushions and through drawers, he crawls under the sofa and shakes out a backpack, they argue by the front door - where the keys turn out to be hanging in the lock the whole time.
transcript: They were right here! Oh, you're kidding!
